prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe draws the yellow card out of the window, lays it flat on the felt in front of the shoe and slides it under her fingertips, flat and yellow side up, to its place close in front of her, in the middle of the picture, where the last frame shows it. She stops it there and lifts her fingertips off it. Then her open hand glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe and takes the next card. As she deals, her head and eyes follow the card, her shoulders turn a little with the reach, and her other hand shifts a little where it lies on the felt. Only one card moves; its back is yellow and its face is blue.
